specific_diseases_listed: Cataract, Glaucoma, disorders of lens, disorders of retina
Pancreatitis and stones in biliary and urinary system
Female genital prolapse, endometriosis/adenomyosis, fibroids, PCOD, hysterectomy
All benign or in situ neoplasms, cysts, sinus, polyp
Gastritis, GERD, ulcer, varices of upper GI tract

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes room/ICU, OT, doctors, medicines, diagnostics, internal implants

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All listed day-care procedures incl AYUSH

ayush_coverage.notes: In-patient AYUSH treatment - Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Within insured's SI; excludes donor pre/post, screening, acquisition, transport

ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance / public transport up to SI

preventive_health_checkup.notes: Above-18 insureds; 12 specified tests at network; up to Rs 900 reimburse if network unavailable

no_claim_bonus_notes: Inflation Protect Sum Insured option - 10% annual SI step-up up to 100% of base SI

modern_treatments.notes: 12 listed modern treatments including HIFU, robotic surgery, BMT stem cell therapy

room_rent_capping: No cap (actual room rent and ICU)

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Treatment outside India excluded unless WW IP cover available in schedule

permanent_exclusions: Treatment outside India (unless WW IP cover)
Spinal subluxation adjustment, muscle stimulation (with exceptions)
notable_exclusions_summary: Specified disease waiting period and 30-day waiting period are NOT applicable for this plan (Platinum). Total SI for basic benefits = Base SI + Inflation Protect SI. Standard ACKO permanent exclusions list applies.
available_riders: Reduction in Specific Illness Waiting Period - Essential
claim_process_summary: Cashless (planned 2 days before; emergency 48 hours; pre-auth TAT 1 hour; final TAT 3 hours) or Reimbursement (15 days from discharge). Penal interest 2% above bank rate for delays beyond 15 days.
